title: Ek aloo mein anant jeev? Jain kyun nahi khate kand-mool
hooks: Ek aloo mein anant jeev? Jain kyun nahi khate?
Aloo kaate to naya paudha? Ye kaise sambhav hai?
Jain kitchen se aloo-pyaaz gayab kyun? Asli reason yeh hai
hook_why: Opens with a shocking visual fact — one potato holds infinite microscopic lives — instantly triggering curiosity about the real reason behind Jain dietary rules.
metaphor: Ek apartment building (aloo) jisme hazaron chhote parivar (nigoda) rehte hain vs ek single-family ghar (seb) jisme ek hi parivar rehta hai
mechanism: Acharanga Sutra classifies root vegetables as anantkay (infinite-bodied)
Anantkay plants host innumerable nigoda souls in one physical form
Nigoda are sub-microscopic life forms existing in vast collectives
Uprooting destroys the whole plant plus soil microorganisms
Regeneration of cut potato proves life distributed throughout tuber
Contrast: pratyek vanaspatikay (fruit) = one body, one soul
Therefore Jain kitchen avoids all root vegetables
Ahimsa extends to every life form, no matter how small

caption:
Ek aloo mein anant nigoda atma rehti hain — yeh hai Jain ahimsa ka sookshm vigyan. Acharanga Sutra ke anusar kand-mool anantkay hain.

Tu hota to kya karta? Comment mein bata.

Jai Jinendra 🙏
